items.name: Frozen Fingers Ghaziabad 2018
items.information: Online Registration ends on 21st December and On the spot registration is available on 29th December from 8:30 to 9:00 AM. The main event for the competition is 3x3 One-Handed. 3x3 One-Handed Winner will be declared the winner of Frozen Fingers Ghaziabad 2018.

items.name: Please Be Quiet Philippines 2018

venue.name: Santiago A. De Guzman Elementary School
venue.address: 2005 Karen Ave. Tanada Subd., Valenzuela, 1440 Metro Manila, Philippines

items.information: This is the first staging of the 'Please Be Quiet' competition in the Philippines. 3x3x3 Blindfolded is the main event of this competition and we will not have 3x3x3 Cube event.

items.name: Sumatra Open 2018

venue.name: Perpustakaan Wilayah Provinsi Riau
venue.address: Jalan Jenderal Sudirman No.462, Jadirejo, Sukajadi, Kota Pekanbaru, Riau 28121
venue.details: Library Hallway, left side of the building (Selasar Perpustakaan, sisi kiri gedung)

items.information: Sumatra Open 2018 is the 4th competition to be held in Pekanbaru, Riau. This competition is capped at **100** competitors. **IMPORTANT!** In accordance with articles 2g, 2k, and 2l, competitors that fail to abide by the specified WCA regulations shall be disqualified, at the discretion of the WCA delegate. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For further information, please contact [Mulyono(+6282286250825)](mailto:mulyono1998@gmail.com) via Email or WhatsApp.
